events.verdict: James (LAL) loses control of the ball on his own prior to any contact from da Silva (ORL).
Carter Jr. (ORL) and Hachimura (LAL) come together at the same spot during the drive.
Black (ORL) legally contests Reaves' (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Banchero (ORL) establishes himself in Hachimura's (LAL) path prior to the contact.
Ayton (LAL) does not maintain verticality and he initiates contact with Banchero's (LAL) arm as he defends the shot.
Ayton (LAL) and Carter Jr. (ORL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Doncic (LAL) gathers the ball on his left foot and takes more than two steps after his gather.

Replay review of the foul called on Carter Jr. (ORL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful.  Carter Jr. directly contests Doncic's (LAL) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Doncic's hand after the release.  The lower body contact that occurs is the result of Doncic extending his right leg outward towards Carter Jr.
Ayton (LAL) briefly grasps Carter Jr.'s (ORL) right arm during the jump ball.
Black (ORL) is moving alongside James' (LAL) path as he defends the drive.
Carter Jr. (ORL) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Black (ORL) makes contact with James' (LAL) arm and affects his jump shot attempt.
Banchero (ORL) establishes himself in Doncic's (LAL) path prior to the contact.
James (LAL) legally contests Bane's (ORL) jump shot attempt.
Bane (ORL) legally contests Hachimura's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Doncic (LAL) deflects the ball away from Banchero (ORL).
Carter Jr. (ORL) makes contact with the ball and with the part of Doncic's (LAL) hand that is on the ball.
Carter Jr. (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Lakers.

As Reaves (LAL) returns to the floor, his arm makes contact with Black's (ORL) head after Black has secured the rebound.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Ayton (LAL) dislodges the ball from Black (ORL).
Doncic (LAL) initiates contact with Carter Jr.'s (ORL) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Isaac (ORL) legally contests James' (LAL) jump shot attempt.
